setup.createSub: Create the administrator account for this server. Choose a name and a strong password.
setup.tokenWhy: This device is not on the server's local network, so setup also needs the one-time setup token. It is shown on the server's screen (at the console login) and in its log (journalctl -u nocapos).
setup.tokenMissing: Enter the setup token. It is shown on the server's screen and in its log.
setup.nameRule: User names are 3–32 letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
setup.passwordShort: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
setup.localHint: This device is on the server's local network, so no setup token is needed.
wiz.title: Set up NoCapOS
wiz.step.name: Name
wiz.introSub: Your account is ready, {name}. A few short steps configure this server. Every step can be skipped and changed later in Settings.
wiz.voiceText: Choose how NoCapOS words its messages. You can change this in Settings.
wiz.lookText: Changes apply immediately so you can preview them.
wiz.modeHint: Light and Auto use the NoCap classic theme; Glass and Cyber-Deck are always dark.
wiz.nameText: The name this server uses on your network.
wiz.hostHint: Other devices can reach it at {name}.local
wiz.hostLen: Enter a name of 1 to 63 characters.
wiz.hostChars: Use only letters, digits and hyphens (not at the start or end), for example living-room-nas.
wiz.hostDigits: The name cannot consist of digits only.
wiz.nativeOnly: This setting requires NoCapOS installed directly on Linux. You can skip it.
wiz.netText: Get an address from your router automatically (DHCP), or set a static address.
wiz.netNone: No adapter here can be configured by NoCapOS. You can skip this step.
wiz.netUnsupported: Network configuration requires NoCapOS on Linux with NetworkManager. You can skip this step.
wiz.netSafe: If this browser cannot reach the server at its new address within one minute, the previous settings are restored automatically.
wiz.netBadV4: Enter the IPv4 address with its prefix, for example 192.168.1.50/24.
wiz.netBadGw4: Enter a valid IPv4 gateway, for example 192.168.1.1.
wiz.netBadDns4: Enter IPv4 DNS servers such as 1.1.1.1, separated by commas.
wiz.netBadV6: Enter the IPv6 address with its prefix, for example fd00::50/64.
wiz.netBadGw6: Enter a valid IPv6 gateway, for example fe80::1.
wiz.netBadDns6: Enter IPv6 DNS servers such as fd00::1, separated by commas.
wiz.timeText: Used for schedules, backups and logs.
wiz.timeSearch: Search for a city or region
wiz.desktop: NoCap Desktop on the server's screen
wiz.desktopHint: Use the server with a monitor, keyboard and mouse like a desktop computer.
wiz.updatesHint: Check now whether a newer version of NoCapOS is available.
wiz.sumText: Review your choices and select Apply. Skipped settings are left unchanged.
wiz.updateAvail: Version {v} is available in Software Update
wiz.netReverted: The server could not be reached at its new address, so the previous network settings were restored.
wiz.netOpenNew: Applying… open the new address to keep the settings:
wiz.netChecking: Applying… checking that the server is still reachable.
wiz.netKept: The new network settings were kept.
wiz.doneText: NoCapOS is ready. Open Launchpad from the Dock to find every app, or press Ctrl+Space to search.
wiz.doneMoved: The server is now available at
